n = int(input())
MOD = 1000000007

grid = [[0] * (n + 1) for _ in range(n + 1)]
totalSum = 0

for i in range(n + 1):
    grid[i][0] = 1
    if (i + 0) % 2 == 1:
        totalSum = (totalSum + grid[i][0]) % MOD

for i in range(1, n + 1):
    for j in range(i, n + 1):
        grid[j][i] = (grid[j][i - 1] + grid[j - 1][i]) % MOD
        if (i + j) % 2 == 1:
            totalSum = (totalSum + grid[j][i]) % MOD

print(totalSum)
